newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar, Data Broadcasting in pact.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar, Data Broadcasting in pact.

text.p: Data Broadcasting Corp and EchoStar Communications Corp said they had agreed to a multi-year deal under which EchoStar will carry the Lawyers Communication Network and other Data Broadcasting programming.
The Lawyers Communication Network is a professional education and online information service jointly developed by Data Broadcasting and the American Bar Association (ABA).
The programming will be carried over EchoStar's DISH Network/Sky, a direct broadcast satellite (DBS) television system that uses 18-inch satellite antennas.
The nationwide service will be offered to the ABA's more than 380,000 members and to non-member lawyers as well.

The deal also calls for EchoStar to carry Data Broadcasting's financial, agribusiness, sports and business television services, as well as the joint development of high-speed data delivery over the same small dish system.
Data Broadcasting's AgCast will be the first data service to be offered over DISH Network/Sky.

Subscribers to Data Broadcasting's services now will be able to receive DBC's core financial, news and sports data services, its new AgCast agribusiness data service, expected to be launched soon, and EchoStar's full video and audio entertainment programming, through the EchoStar systetm.
On February 24, EchoStar announced an alliance with Rupert Murdoch's News Corp in which News Corp will invest cash and assets worth $1 billion in exchange for a 50 percent stake in EchoStar.
Data Broadcasting is a leading provider of real-time market data to the individual investor.
